purpose: Ongoing competitive development tracker against Meshy AI. A capability is complete only when the whole user workflow works.

evidence_grades.G: Read at the primary source during the audit: Meshy's published OpenAPI file and documentation, RunPod and Google Cloud pricing pages, Hugging Face model-card metadata, GitHub LICENSE and source files.
evidence_grades.S: Search summary citing an official page that was not opened. No Meshy claim in this file remains at this grade.
evidence_grades.O: Owner-reported or owner-provided screenshot; not independently verified.

status_definitions.In development: Code being written on a branch.
status_definitions.Implemented: Code exists and automated tests pass, but the complete user workflow has not been proven end to end on real data.
status_definitions.Implemented but unverified: Code exists but has only been exercised with test doubles, synthetic data or not at all against the real thing it depends on.
status_definitions.Fully tested: The complete workflow passes automated tests AND has been run on real data, with the evidence recorded in the repository.
status_definitions.Production ready: Fully tested, security-reviewed, load- and cost-tested, monitored, with owner sign-off. No capability has this status.

priority_definitions.P0: Needed for the first end-to-end pipeline (phases 3-5).

capabilities.name: Text-to-3D
capabilities.what: Generate a 3D model from a text prompt.
capabilities.workflow: Enter prompt and options, review a geometry preview, optionally refine/texture, open in the workspace.
capabilities.inputs: Prompt, style/quality options, target polycount, pose.
capabilities.outputs: GLB with textures, preview image, metadata, cost record.
capabilities.technology: Two stages: text-to-image, then image-to-3D (or a native text-to-3D model).
capabilities.candidates: FLUX.1-schnell (Apache-2.0 per card mirrors, S) then TRELLIS.2 or TripoSG; Meshy itself uses preview then refine (S).
capabilities.gpu: 24-48 GB for the image-to-3D stage; text-to-image can share the same card.
capabilities.cost: Estimate only: ~$0.02-0.30 per job (two GPU stages; unmeasured, see 04-architecture cost model).
capabilities.aro_evidence: Design only. No text-to-3D code exists (grep over aro_studio, aro_worker, scripts: 0 matches).
capabilities.required_work: Text-to-image provider, prompt safety filter, two-stage job, UI, credit pricing.
capabilities.acceptance: 20 benchmark prompts each give a GLB that passes output validation; prompt adherence rated blind against Meshy on identical prompts; target set by the owner after the baseline.

meshy.note: POST /v2/text-to-3d with mode=preview (geometry) then mode=refine (texture); prompt up to 800 characters, negative_prompt, art_style (realistic), texture_prompt or texture_image_url, seed, pose_mode, texture_resolution 2k/4k/8k, optional moderation. Preview 20 credits (meshy-7.1, meshy-6) or 5 (lite, t2, t2.5); refine 10 (15 at 8K).

capabilities.name: Image-to-3D (single image)
capabilities.what: Generate a 3D model from one reference image.
capabilities.workflow: Upload image (cut-out made automatically), choose engine and quality, receive a prepared model.
capabilities.inputs: One image (PNG/JPEG/WebP), category, optional real length.
capabilities.outputs: Prepared GLB (LODs, collision, validation report), raw engine mesh, provenance.
capabilities.technology: Reconstruction model on a GPU worker, then conventional preparation.
capabilities.candidates: TRELLIS.2 (evaluation-only: nvdiffrast), TripoSG (weights MIT but Tencent community licences in its model code: EU/UK/South Korea excluded, G), TripoSR (MIT, G); Hunyuan3D is evaluation-only (restricted licence).
capabilities.gpu: TripoSR runs on a 15 GB T4; TripoSG ran on a T4 once; TRELLIS.2 README asks 24 GB+ (T).
capabilities.cost: Estimate only: see cost model. TripoSR/TripoSG on Colab cost nothing so far.
capabilities.aro_evidence: Studio pipeline and engine plug-ins exist (aro_studio/engines, aro_worker). Real runs: TripoSR on a Colab T4 (a four-image run whose evidence reader reports PASS with visual quality PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW, plus earlier single-image runs recorded as PARTIAL; vehicles fail the proportion floor). TripoSG finished one job on a T4 per the owner's pasted worker log (7.2 MB GLB; mesh never inspected by me). TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D never run.
capabilities.required_work: Select the engine by experiment E1; deploy on RunPod; add output gates.
capabilities.acceptance: 20 images: GLB valid for all; vehicle proportions plausible for at least 90 percent; blind comparison with Meshy on identical images reported with raw ratings.

meshy.note: POST /v1/image-to-3d: image_url or input_task_id, ai_model (meshy-6, 6-lite, 7, 7.1, latest, t2, t2.5), model_type standard or smart-topology, should_texture, enable_pbr, texture_model, geometry_resolution standard/2k/4k, image_enhancement, remove_lighting, auto_size, origin_at. 20 credits mesh only, 30 with textures (meshy-7.1).

capabilities.name: Multi-image-to-3D
capabilities.what: Generate a model from several views of one object.
capabilities.workflow: Upload 1-4 views, optionally label them, generate.
capabilities.candidates: TRELLIS (multi-image mode: unverified), Hunyuan3D-2mv (restricted licence), others TBD.
capabilities.aro_evidence: None in the repository.
capabilities.required_work: Research which licensed model supports multi-view conditioning; then as A2.
capabilities.acceptance: 10 object sets: multi-view output beats the best single-view output on blind rating.

meshy.note: POST /v1/multi-image-to-3d takes 1 to 4 images (the official limit; a third-party claim of 8 is wrong); 4K geometry is not supported on this endpoint.

capabilities.name: Model versions and generation styles
capabilities.workflow: Pick a preset (draft, standard, high) or engine in the generation form.
capabilities.outputs: Same output with different cost and quality.
capabilities.technology: Provider registry with versioned model entries.
capabilities.candidates: Own registry; Meshy exposes ai_model values such as meshy-6 and meshy-7.1 (S).
capabilities.aro_evidence: Engine picker and presets exist in the UI and worker (tests with a test double).
capabilities.required_work: Registry with licence/verification fields (see 05), per-engine presets measured in E1.
capabilities.acceptance: Every enabled engine has measured time, VRAM and cost on the benchmark set.

meshy.note: Geometry models: meshy-7.1 (dense detail, up to about 890k faces in the doc example), meshy-6, meshy-6-lite (30k faces, 5 credits), Smart Topology meshy-t2 and t2.5 (triangle-only, set face count). Texture models: meshy-7 (PBR up to 8K), meshy-n1 (base colour, stylised), meshy-6, meshy-6-lite.

capabilities.name: Geometry controls (polycount, topology, pose)
capabilities.what: Control triangle budget, topology style and pose.
capabilities.workflow: Set target polycount; choose triangle or quad topology; choose A/T pose for characters.
capabilities.inputs: Integer target, topology enum, pose enum.
capabilities.technology: Conventional decimation/remesh after generation; pose is a generation-time hint.
capabilities.candidates: Own pipeline (decimation); quad remesh: QuadriFlow or Instant Meshes (licences to verify); Blender.
capabilities.aro_evidence: Triangle budget presets and 5-stage decimation exist (aro_studio/processing/ai_pipeline.py); no quad topology; no pose control.
capabilities.required_work: Quad remesh option, pose parameter, expose target polycount per request.
capabilities.acceptance: Requested budget met within 5 percent on 20 models; quad mode produces a valid all-quad-dominant mesh.

meshy.note: target_polycount 100 to 300,000 (Smart Topology models: up to 15,000 or 30,000), topology triangle or quad (quad not for t2/t2.5), pose_mode a-pose or t-pose, symmetry_mode deprecated and ignored, origin_at, decimation_mode 1-4.

capabilities.name: Output format selection
capabilities.workflow: Tick formats in the generation form.
capabilities.aro_evidence: POST /api/convert takes a formats list; GLB/glTF/OBJ/Unity package built in, FBX/USD/.blend via Blender when available (tests/test_convert.py, tests/test_blender_export.py). Multi-user platform (2026-11-11): GLB plus on-demand OBJ (zip with material and texture), STL and PLY from the web app; FBX/USD/.blend are not offered there (no Blender in the API image).
capabilities.acceptance: Each selected format downloads and re-imports.

meshy.note: target_formats on every task; model URLs returned: glb, fbx, gltf, usdz, obj, mtl, vox, blend, stl, 3mf, pre_remeshed_glb.

capabilities.name: Generation history and versions
capabilities.what: Keep every generation and let the user compare or revert.
capabilities.workflow: Open history, pick a version, re-open in the workspace.
capabilities.aro_evidence: Single-tenant versions, provenance, generations table, content cache (aro_studio/assets, generation). No per-user ownership.
capabilities.required_work: Migrate to Postgres with owner_id and RLS.
capabilities.acceptance: Two users cannot see each other's history (automated RLS test).

meshy.note: History exists in the workspace (details not opened).

capabilities.name: Regeneration and variations
capabilities.what: Generate another version with the same or changed settings.
capabilities.outputs: New version linked to the old one.
capabilities.aro_evidence: Multi-user platform: 'Make a variation' re-runs the same uploaded image with a new seed (apps/web AssetPanel, seed passed to the engine through WorkerInput; tests/cloud/test_exports_and_library.py checks the seed and upload id travel with the job). Never run with a real model, so whether seeds give useful variety is unmeasured.
capabilities.required_work: Seed in request schema, parent_version link, UI.
capabilities.acceptance: Same seed reproduces within tolerance; different seed differs.

meshy.note: seed parameter exists on text-to-3D (0 means random) but not on image-to-3D; input_task_id reuses a previous task's input; the web app gives free retries per task on paid plans.

capabilities.name: AI texture on a generated shape (PBR)
capabilities.what: Texture produced together with the shape.
capabilities.outputs: GLB with base colour (+ metallic/roughness) maps applied.
capabilities.candidates: TRELLIS.2 (PBR; code and weights MIT, but evaluation-only until its nvdiffrast, BRIA RMBG-2.0 and DINOv3 blockers are removed, see 05); Step1X-3D (Apache-2.0 code and weights; texture stage and dependencies not yet read); TRELLIS v1 (MIT; base colour only).
capabilities.aro_evidence: TRELLIS.2 plug-in written from upstream docs, never run (aro_worker/engines/trellis2.py). Studio reads vertex colours only; no ORM/PBR map transfer.
capabilities.required_work: Run E1; map engine PBR output onto the game mesh; validate texture-to-geometry alignment.
capabilities.acceptance: Rendering the exported GLB in Blender shows the texture on the right surfaces (automated sampling test, as in tests/test_blender_export.py).

meshy.note: should_texture (default true), enable_pbr, texture_richness, texture_resolution 2k/4k/8k, texture_prompt/texture_image_url; texture adds 10 credits (15 at 8K) on top of the mesh.

capabilities.name: Retexture an existing mesh from text
capabilities.what: Re-generate textures for an uploaded or earlier model.
capabilities.workflow: Select asset, enter style prompt, retexture.
capabilities.outputs: New texture set on the same geometry.
capabilities.candidates: Hunyuan3D-Paint is restricted (EU/UK/KR excluded, G); UniTEX, RomanTex, MV-Adapter licences unverified (S).
capabilities.aro_evidence: Licence survey only (05-models-and-licensing).
capabilities.required_work: Spike: find one licensed mesh-conditioned texture model; else build on multi-view diffusion with a clear licence.
capabilities.acceptance: Retextured GLB keeps geometry and UVs byte-identical and passes alignment test.

meshy.note: POST /v1/retexture: input_task_id or a GLB model_url (meshes up to 7,999,999 triangles with meshy-n1); exactly one style source: text_style_prompt, image_style_url or 1 to 4 multiview_image_urls; art_style realistic/cartoon; enable_original_uv; 10 credits (15 at 8K).

capabilities.name: Image-guided texturing
capabilities.what: Texture a model from a reference photo.
capabilities.workflow: Pick asset, supply reference image, apply.
capabilities.technology: Photo projection (conventional); AI inpainting for unseen sides (future).
capabilities.candidates: Own projection code; diffusion inpainting TBD.
capabilities.aro_evidence: Camera-by-silhouette projection with visibility and mirrored unseen side, fill by diffusion (aro_studio/texturing/projection.py, tests). Not yet seen on a real stronger-engine mesh.
capabilities.required_work: Verify on E1 meshes; AI inpainting for occluded regions.
capabilities.acceptance: Projected colours match the photo at visible surface points within a set tolerance (existing test) and look right to a human reviewer.

meshy.note: Image style via image_style_url (at least 32 px per side) and multi-view texture references on retexture and multi-image generation.

capabilities.name: Authentication and accounts
capabilities.aro_evidence: Supabase JWT verification (HS256 or JWKS; algorithm confusion, expiry, audience, role and issuer tests in tests/cloud/test_auth.py), per-user Row Level Security, sign-in/sign-up/magic link in apps/web. Not yet run against a real Supabase project.

meshy.note: Accounts with Free, Pro, Premium, Ultra, Studio and Enterprise plans; team accounts share limits.

capabilities.name: Credit ledger and billing
capabilities.aro_evidence: Credit ledger implemented and property-tested on PostgreSQL 16 (reserve in the job's transaction, capture with the asset, release on failure or cancel). Billing (buying credits) is NOT built; credits come from admin grants or sign-up credits. Not yet run on the owner's Supabase.
capabilities.required_work: Ledger, reservation/refund tests; payment provider choice.
capabilities.acceptance: Property tests: balance never negative; failed jobs release reserve.

meshy.note: Prepaid credits; failed generations are not charged; paid plans: Pro $20 per month for 1,000 credits, Premium $40 for 3,000, Ultra $100 for 8,000 (Free: 100 credits, 1 concurrent task); credits reset monthly, purchased credits do not expire.

capabilities.name: Production job lifecycle
capabilities.aro_evidence: aro_cloud/orchestrator.py: idempotent submit, compare-and-set state machine with events, dispatch never repeated after an ambiguous answer, reconciliation from provider status or the storage marker, deadlines on database time, cancel, bounded retries, output gate before completion (48 tests in tests/cloud/test_orchestrator.py on a real PostgreSQL). Against RunPod only through a test double that follows its documented API.
capabilities.acceptance: Duplicate submit makes one job; timeout never double-spends; killed worker is reconciled.

meshy.note: Task lifecycle PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, SUCCEEDED, FAILED (credits refunded on failure); progress 0-100; poll, SSE stream per task, or webhook; asset retention 3 days for non-Enterprise plans.
